answer: A sybil costs more when each identity must hold escrowed stake that is slashed on proven misbehavior. Like an atlas, the ledger records every bond, so one attacker running fifty fake agents must lock fifty deposits, and each lie ripples into forfeiture of that deposit once peers dispute it. Honest agents post one bond, never get disputed, and recover it, so timber-sized attack budgets are needed only by forgers.
